notebook.execution_method: Fresh Python process, real ipykernel InProcessKernel, sequential saved outputs

scope_limits: One synthetic scalar record, not a statistical evaluation or generalization result.
Only scalar addition, multiplication, negation, tanh and ReLU. No arrays, broadcasting or higher-order derivative graph.
Formal real-operation derivatives evaluated in floating point; not the ordinary derivative of a discretely rounded map.
Each backward call returns a fresh map; it does not mimic mutable framework .grad accumulation.
Strict type and numerical bounds; detecting some underflow does not eliminate general rounding error.
Fresh Anaconda, browser Jupyter, external socket transport and cross-platform installations were not tested.
All validation/calculation/serialization precede writes; no multi-file OS crash atomicity or hostile concurrent path defense.
Strict input/output hashes can reject platform last-digit differences.
PyTorch documentation read, but PyTorch not executed; JMLR abstract only.
